validity.researcher_notes: Wiki citations show a real line of about 880 km, 1420 mm pipe, Gazprom investor, built 2018 to 2021 and feeding Nord Stream 2 and Ust-Luga. Caveat: the contractor finished pipe construction in November 2021 and a regional item reports commissioning in 2021, while the sheet start year is 2022 (compressor shops, per the Ukhta report). The 84.2 bcm per year is a planning scheme design volume of March 2020.

fills.researcher_notes: RIA Novosti of 20 March 2020 quotes the updated federal pipeline planning scheme: design transport volume of 84.2 billion cubic meters per year for the Gryazovets to Slavyanskaya section. This is a planned design figure from 2020.

A Gazregion contractor page (Wayback capture of August 2022) says the pipe diameter is 1420 mm for the Gryazovets to Slavyanskaya line. The sheet holds 55.91, which is 1420 mm in inches. The page covers the 93 km section built by that contractor, in the same project.

The same contractor page names PAO Gazprom as investor of the Gryazovets to Slavyanskaya line and Gazprom Invest as client. It does not say who holds title, so the owner is inferred from the investor.
